lines.en: label yasudorm25:
scene dorm2
I make my way over to the dorm and find that things are significantly quieter on this floor than normal.
lines.zh: 我走到宿舍，发现这层楼今晚比平时安静得多。

lines.en: Typically, I’d be accompanied by the sound of Molly yelling at some game, Noriko blasting music, Io banging away at some sort of craft, Nodoka throwing things around, and-
lines.zh: 通常我会被这些声音包围：Molly 冲着某个游戏大喊，Noriko 放音乐，Io 敲敲打打做什么手工，Nodoka 把东西扔来扔去，还有——

lines.en: Actually, now that I think of it, Dorm 9 is kind of an outlier here.
lines.zh: 其实，现在想想，9 号宿舍在这儿算是个异类。

lines.en: Yasu might be clinically insane and a delusional cultist, but whenever she’s in her room, she’s normally just...staring at the wall. And Touka’s rather quiet and polite to begin with, so...
lines.zh: Yasu 也许临床意义上疯了、是个妄想的邪教分子，但只要她在屋里，通常就只是……盯着墙看。而 Touka 本来就安静有礼貌，所以……

lines.en: You know what? Maybe I’ll spend some time with them tonight.
lines.zh: 你知道吗？也许我今晚该跟她们待一会儿。

lines.en: menu:
Knock on the door of Dorm #9
lines.zh: 敲 9 号宿舍的门

lines.en: scene yasudormevent1
When I step in front of the door, I realize that they’ve changed their sign.
lines.zh: 当我站到门前，我意识到她们换了门牌。

lines.en: I liked the older one more as it didn’t remind me of my least favorite letter or any sort of religious symbolism.
lines.zh: 我更喜欢旧的那块，因为它不会让我想起我最不喜欢的字母、或者任何宗教象征。

lines.en: Well, apart from the number 9’s suggested correlation to finality or completeness and how it is subsequently and commonly associated with the death of the Messiah, Jesus Christ of Nazareth.
lines.zh: 好吧，除了数字 9 暗示的与「终局」或「完满」的关联，以及它随后被普遍联系到弥赛亚、拿撒勒人耶稣基督之死这件事。

lines.en: I am not a Christian — I am not {i}anything.{/i} But I {i}would{/i} have liked to grab a beer with Jesus if the two of us were ever alive at the same time.
lines.zh: 我不是基督徒——我{i}什么{/i}都不是。不过如果我俩曾活在同一个时代，我{i}倒{/i}挺想跟耶稣去喝杯啤酒。

lines.en: There wasn’t much else to do back then, so I’m sure he’d be able to hold his liquor. And I’m doubly sure since he apparently bled wine or however it’s supposed to go.
lines.zh: 那时候也没别的事可干，所以我确信他酒量不错。而我更是加倍确信——因为他显然流的是葡萄酒，或者不管那故事该怎么讲。

lines.en: I’m no expert, so don’t take my word.
lines.zh: 我不是专家，别听我的。

lines.en: I think for a moment about what I want to do when I enter the room- but I know in my heart of hearts that anything I desire now will be slaughtered the moment I make eye contact with Touka’s boobs.
lines.zh: 我想了一会儿进屋后要干什么——可我心里清楚，任何我现在想要的东西，都会在我跟 Touka 的胸部对上眼的那一刻被屠宰。

lines.en: She has really good boobs.
lines.zh: 她的胸真的很好。

lines.en: I wish it was her who became possessed by a false god only to tackle me and have an accidental orgasm while her eyes roll to the back of her head and drool drips out of her mouth and onto my face.
lines.zh: 我真希望是被假神附身、然后扑倒我、意外高潮、眼珠翻到脑后、口水滴到我脸上的人是她。

lines.en: It’s a very specific thing to want, which means it likely will not happen.
lines.zh: 那是个非常具体的愿望，所以大概不会发生。

lines.en: And if I am to relive such a situation again, it will probably be with Yasu.
lines.zh: 而如果我要再经历一次那种场面，大概会跟 Yasu。

lines.en: Her boobs aren’t as nice. They’ve barely started growing. And I can’t help but feel like she’d be less fun to have penetrative sex with because she’d likely be preaching or crying the entire time.
lines.zh: 她的胸没那么好。才刚开始发育。而且我忍不住觉得，跟她做插入式性爱会没那么有趣，因为她大概全程都在布道或者哭。

lines.en: I don’t want to deal with that.
lines.zh: 我不想应付那个。

lines.en: Instead, I will hearken back to the thoughts I had of liquor just moments ago and make a trip to the alcohol shop so I can get the two of them drunk and plug their holes with my man meat without being remembered.
lines.zh: 相反，我要回到刚才想到的酒那件事上——跑一趟酒铺，把这俩灌醉，然后用我的男人肉堵住她们的洞，还不被记住。

lines.en: It’s the best way to do sex since I’d be able to move their bodies however I want.
lines.zh: 这是做爱最好的方式，因为那样我就能随心所欲地摆弄她们的身体。

lines.en: I just hope they can’t drink as much as me.
lines.zh: 我只希望她们酒量没我好。

lines.en: scene yasudormevent2
I turn around to begin-
lines.zh: 我转身准备——

lines.en: I forget what I was beginning to do.
lines.zh: 我忘了自己正要开始干什么。

lines.en: Yasu stares at me and the earliest signs of my erection begin to subside and convert me back into my normal form — Flaccid Dick Boy, Kid Bandit.
lines.zh: Yasu 盯着我，我勃起的最早征兆开始消退，把我变回原形——软鸡巴小子，小裤匪。

lines.en: It’s a nickname I received on the playground a long time ago after having my gym shorts pulled down by a girl in the grade above me who wanted to see a penis for the first time after learning about them in health class.
lines.zh: 这是我很久以前在操场上得到的外号：一个高我一年级的女孩在健康课上学到阴茎之后，想第一次看看真的，就把我的运动短裤扒了下来。

lines.en: She asked if she could touch it and I said no, so she began to call me names. Flaccid Dick Boy, Kid Bandit was one of them.
lines.zh: 她问能不能摸，我说不行，于是她开始给我起外号。「软鸡巴小子，小裤匪」就是其中一个。

lines.en: She was a very strange girl.
lines.zh: 她是个非常奇怪的女孩。

lines.en: But not as strange as this one — who probably doesn’t even want to see my penis.
lines.zh: 但没这位奇怪——这位大概连看都不想看我的阴茎。

lines.en: What’s up with that?
lines.zh: 这算怎么回事？

lines.en: : Are you lost, little lamb?
lines.zh: : 你迷路了吗，小羊羔？

lines.en: : Nope. Just heading over to the liquor store.
lines.zh: : 没有。正要去酒铺。

lines.en: : The consumption of alcohol will only taint your body. You must keep yourself pure so God does not get drunk on your light when he collects it in your sleep.
lines.zh: : 饮酒只会玷污你的身体。你必须保持纯净，好让神在你睡着时收取你的光时，不会醉倒。

lines.en: : Wow, way to be a buzzkill.
lines.zh: : 哇，真会扫兴。

lines.en: : I ask you, Sensei...where do you think you are right now?
lines.zh: : 我问你，老师……你觉得你现在在哪儿？

lines.en: : The dorms, obviously.
lines.zh: : 宿舍啊，明显。

lines.en: : But where do you think the {i}dorms{/i} are?
lines.zh: : 可你觉得{i}宿舍{/i}在哪儿？

lines.en: : Kumon-mi?
lines.zh: : Kumon-mi？

lines.en: : It’s funny how looking at things from a different angle can change all you know to be real.
lines.zh: : 有趣的是，换个角度看东西，能把你所知的一切真实都改变。

lines.en: : It’s even funnier how you can ignore that until it’s pointed out to you.
lines.zh: : 更有趣的是，你可以一直无视它，直到被人指出来。

lines.en: : Uhh...
: This is how it always looks — half complete. Just like you.
lines.zh: : 它一直都是这个样子——完成了一半。就像你一样。

lines.en: : It’s the same place you visit every single day, but brand new at the same time as it’s a side of it you’re never {i}meant{/i} to see.
lines.zh: : 这是你每天都要来的同一个地方，可同时又崭新，因为这是你{i}本不该{/i}看到的那一面。

lines.en: : But this is {i}all{/i} I see whenever you’re away.
lines.zh: : 可你不在的时候，我看到的{i}全{/i}是这个。

lines.en: : This abyss is my only company every single Thursday.
lines.zh: : 每个星期四，这片深渊是我唯一的同伴。

lines.en: : That’s not true. You normally have Kirin as well.
lines.zh: : 不对。你平时还有 Kirin。

lines.en: : Kirin only exists when you need her to. The same way the dorms only exist when you need them to.
lines.zh: : Kirin 只在你需要的时���候存在。就像宿舍只在你需要的时���候存在。

lines.en: : But what becomes of us whenever you don’t?
lines.zh: : 可你不需要的时候，我们会变成什么？

lines.en: : Does a hummingbird hum when it runs out of songs?
lines.zh: : 蜂鸟把歌哼完了，还会哼吗？

lines.en: : Yasu, I don’t mean to “Um, actually” you in the middle of philosophical speech, but I’m pretty sure they’re only called hummingbirds because their {i}wings{/i} hum. Not because they sing.
lines.zh: : Yasu，我不是想在你哲学演讲的中途「呃，其实」你一下，不过我很确定它们叫蜂鸟是因为{i}翅膀{/i}会嗡嗡响，不是因为它们唱歌。

lines.en: : Is that your only concern when being faced with the truth? You’re more worried about why things are called what they’re called than who decided to call them that?
lines.zh: : 面对真相时，你唯一的关注点就是这个？比起「谁决定这么叫它们」，你更在意「东西为什么被这么叫」？

lines.en: : You came to me in search of salvation, did you not? If you truly wish to learn, you will need to put more thought into my words.
lines.zh: : 你来找我是为了寻求救赎，不是吗？如果你真想学到东西，就得对我的话多用点心。

lines.en: scene yasudormevent3
: When everyone disappears, there is a special bridge that forms.
lines.zh: : 当所有人消失时，会形成一座特别的桥。

lines.en: : It extends beyond the abyss into another plane that only the purest of young girls can reach — and every door and every number turns to ash to be carried away with the breaths of the sky.
lines.zh: : 它越过深渊，延伸到另一重位面——只有最纯洁的少女才能抵达——而每一扇门、每一个数字都化为灰烬，随天空的呼吸被带走。

lines.en: : It all looks like this — unfinished and underwhelming. But empty space does not fit in with our ideal reality, so we reject it.
lines.zh: : 一切看起来都是这样——未完成、令人失望。可空洞的空间与我们理想中的现实格格不入，所以我们拒绝它。

lines.en: : Why are {i}we{/i} the ones who sleep apart?
lines.zh: : 为什么{i}我们{/i}是分开睡的那些人？

lines.en: : Why is {i}our{/i} home the one left incomplete?
lines.zh: : 为什么{i}我们{/i}的家是那个没建完的？

lines.en: : And what is the need for so many floors when there are so few of us?
lines.zh: : 而我们人这么少，为什么需要这么多层楼？

lines.en: : Yasu, you’re starting to-
lines.zh: : Yasu，你开始——

lines.en: scene yasudormevent4
: Scare you?
lines.zh: : 吓到你了？

lines.en: : Make you uncomfortable?
lines.zh: : 让你不舒服了？

lines.en: : It is all for good reason.
lines.zh: : 这一切都是有理由的。

lines.en: : It is all so one day, you will enter me. And we will create a new lifeform unlike anything the world has ever seen.
lines.zh: : 这一切都是为了有一天，你会进入我。然后我们将创造一种这世界从未见过的新生命。

lines.en: : I really don’t-
lines.zh: : 我真的不——

lines.en: : It’s time to go.
lines.zh: : 该走了。

lines.en: : Go where? Where are-
lines.zh: : 去哪儿？你在——

lines.en: scene yasudormevent5
scene yasudormevent6
I am born.
lines.zh: 我诞生了。

lines.en: In my second coming, I become reacquainted with the inside of a uterus and how terrifying it is to see light for the first time.
lines.zh: 在我的第二次降临时，我重新熟悉了子宫内部，以及第一次见到光有多可怕。

lines.en: And while it may look like I lack the eyes required to see {i}anything,{/i} I can assure you that isn’t true.
lines.zh: 虽然看起来我似乎没有用来看{i}东西{/i}的眼睛，但我可以向你保证并非如此。

lines.en: A soft hand guides me down a flight of stairs that I can feel, but what lies before me in this temporary realm is much different than any stack of sturdy rectangles.
lines.zh: 一只柔软的手引我走下一段我能感觉到的楼梯，但在这临时的领域里，我面前的东西跟任何一摞结实的长方形都不一样。

lines.en: A ticking clock and the equally repetitive noise of a door opening and closing.
lines.zh: 一只滴答作响的钟，以及同样重复的、门开了又关的声音。

lines.en: The sounds of animals fighting over scraps of food plucked from trash cans by scavenger birds and dropped before they were able to be safeguarded.
lines.zh: 动物争抢着从垃圾桶里被食腐鸟叼出来、又来不及藏好的食物碎屑的声音。

lines.en: The soft hand reminds me that I am no scavenger bird, but a piece of trash — waiting to be ripped to shreds or torn apart by something that sees me as weak.
lines.zh: 那只柔软的手提醒我：我不是食腐鸟，而是一件垃圾——等着被撕成碎片，或者被某个视我为弱者的东西扯开。

lines.en: It is quite possible the hand is only leading me away from my happy place because it wants to do this.
lines.zh: 那只手很可能只是想这么做，才把我从快乐的地方引开。

lines.en: My bones will go on to form the base of its nest and my skin will make an excellent jacket after being cured and tanned.
lines.zh: 我的骨头会去构成它巢穴的底部，我的皮肤经过腌制和鞣制之后会变成一件上好的外套。

lines.en: My phallus and testicles may be preserved for personal use or eaten fresh depending on the predator’s personal preferences, but I like to believe they’ll simply be left alone.
lines.zh: 我的阴茎和睾丸也许会被保存下来供私用，或者按捕食者的个人喜好新鲜吃掉，不过我愿意相信它们会被就这么搁着不碰。

lines.en: I am a lost, little lamb- and the outside world is scary.
lines.zh: 我是一只迷路的小羊羔——而外面的世界很可怕。

lines.en: That’s why I found a shepherd.
lines.zh: 所以我找了一个牧羊人。

lines.en: That’s why I’ll keep her close.
lines.zh: 所以我会把她留在身边。

lines.en: : {i}Wake up.{/i}
scene yasudormevent7
if makotofutabafuntimelustevent == True:
I blink and wind up in a somewhat familiar place — filled with memories that may be good for me but not so much for others.
lines.zh: 我眨了眨眼，来到一个有几分熟悉的地方——塞满了对我有好处、对别人没那么有好处的回忆。

lines.en: else:
I blink and wind up in an unfamiliar place — full of trees and leaves and other things.
lines.zh: 我眨了眨眼，来到一个陌生的地方——满是树、叶子和别的东西。

lines.en: The wind is blowing hard, but none of the foliage is moving- and it appears that only {i}I{/i} am feeling the effects of this.
lines.zh: 风刮得很猛，可没有一片叶子在动——而且似乎只有{i}我{/i}感受到了它的效果。

lines.en: Did I black out again?
lines.zh: 我又断片了？

lines.en: Did something happen in the dorms that triggered it?
lines.zh: 是宿舍里发生了什么触发了它？

lines.en: scene yasudormevent8
And why am I with Yasu of all people?
lines.zh: 还有，为什么偏偏是跟 Yasu 在一起？

lines.en: Did she follow me?
lines.zh: 她跟着我？

lines.en: Was this {i}her{/i} idea?
lines.zh: 这是{i}她{/i}的主意？

lines.en: Am I even here at all? Or could this be another mind-game she’s attempting to-
lines.zh: 我到底在不在这儿？还是说这又是她试图玩的另一场心理游戏——

lines.en: : Thinking too hard will only make things more difficult for you.
lines.zh: : 想太多只会让事情对你更难。

lines.en: : In order to fully grasp the underlying purpose in all of this, you must free your mind from the walls you’ve built around it and devote yourself to the cause.
lines.zh: : 要完全抓住这一切背后的目的，你必须把心智从你围着它砌起的墙里放出来，并献身于这项事业。

lines.en: : Only then, will you fully secure the hiding place you seek. And only then will you avoid ruin.
lines.zh: : 只有到那时，你才能彻底守住你寻找的藏身之处。也只有到那时，你才能避开毁灭。

lines.en: scene yasudormevent9
: Yasu, where are we? Why did you take me here?
lines.zh: : Yasu，我们在哪儿？你为什么把我带到这儿？

lines.en: : You asked me to shepherd you...I am simply doing as you wish.
lines.zh: : 你求我牧养你……我只是在照你的愿望做。

lines.en: : I didn’t {i}ask{/i} you to do that. It’s something you decided on your own.
lines.zh: : 我没{i}求{/i}你那么做。那是你自己决定的。

lines.en: : While the words did not cross your lips, it is what you agreed to when you joined me on the pew. And so it is here where I will teach you something new.
lines.zh: : 虽然那些话没经过你的嘴唇，但那是你跟我同坐一条长椅时就同意的事。所以我要在这儿教你一些新的东西。

lines.en: : But know that even the most experienced of shepherds often struggle to corral the most disobedient sheep — and that none of this matters at all if you do not {i}obey{/i} to some extent.
lines.zh: : 不过你要知道，连最有经验的牧羊人也常常难以把最不听话的羊赶拢——而如果你不肯多少{i}顺从{/i}一点，这一切都毫无意义。

lines.en: : He can give, but only so much. And that directly influences what you should {i}take.{/i}
lines.zh: : 祂能给予，但只能给予那么多。而那直接影响你该{i}拿{/i}多少。

lines.en: scene yasudormevent10
: Can you maybe shepherd me back to the dorms now? The last time I got lost in the woods with a weird girl, I became an accomplice to child abduction.
lines.zh: : 你能不能现在就牧养我回宿舍？上次我跟一个怪女孩在林子里迷路，结果成了拐卖儿童的共犯。

lines.en: : You’ll return after you’ve learned today’s lesson.
lines.zh: : 你学完今天的课就回去。

lines.en: : Well...what’s today’s lesson?
lines.zh: : 嗯……今天的课是什么？

lines.en: scene yasudormevent11
: What is and isn’t real.
lines.zh: : 什么是真的，什么不是。

lines.en: : As a man who has seen God, it would not be unusual for you to see {i}other{/i} things as well.
lines.zh: : 作为一个见过神的人，你会看见{i}别的{/i}东西也不算稀奇。

lines.en: : Only He can show you how to discern fiction from reality as it is He who determines what can and can not exist in our world.
lines.zh: : 只有祂能教你怎么分辨虚构与现实，因为正是祂决定什么能、什么不能存在于我们的世界。

lines.en: : Everything flows through our precious God. And it is in the depths of the rivers of His infinite wisdom that insignificant worms like us learn to see {i}without{/i} our eyes, but with something else.
lines.zh: : 一切都流经我们珍贵的神。而正是在祂无限智慧那河流的深处，像我们这样微不足道的虫子学会{i}不用{/i}眼睛看，而是用别的什么看。

lines.en: : You’re not going to say “our hearts,” are you?
lines.zh: : 你不会要说「我们的心」吧？

lines.en: : If only it were that simple.
lines.zh: : 要是那么简单就好了。

lines.en: : The concept of reality is one of great interest to Him as there have been others in the past just like you — who craft wings of feather and wax only to fly too close to the sun in the days that come next.
lines.zh: : 「现实」这个概念让祂极感兴趣，因为过去也有过像你一样的人——用羽毛和蜡做翅膀，然后在接下来的日子里飞得离太阳太近。

lines.en: : Uhh...
: What I am saying is that you should not get too close to that which does not exist — for it is a greater danger to you than anything else you could ever imagine.
lines.zh: : 我的意思是：你不该太靠近那些不存在的东西——因为它对你的危险，超过你能想象的任何事。

lines.en: : This world is a wonderful one, but there are things trying to exist here that simply shouldn’t.
lines.zh: : 这个世界很美好，但有些试图存在于此的东西根本不该存在。

lines.en: : Well...how am I supposed to know what’s real and what’s not if only {i}He{/i} can tell or whatever? How is any of this helpful?
lines.zh: : 嗯……可如果只有{i}祂{/i}能断定什么的，我要怎么知道什么是真的、什么不是？这些有什么用？

lines.en: : I haven’t told you how to see without your eyes yet. Of course you’d be confused.
lines.zh: : 我还没告诉你怎么不用眼睛看呢。你当然会困惑。

lines.en: : Then tell me, Yasu. Because if you really want me to {i}learn{/i} any of this, you’re going to need to cut back on these long-winded speeches.
lines.zh: : 那就告诉我，Yasu。因为如果你真想让我{i}学会{/i}这些，你就得少来点这种长篇大论。

lines.en: : You must learn to see through His eyes instead.
lines.zh: : 你必须学会透过祂的眼睛看。

lines.en: : Oh, okay. So the big lesson when it comes to figuring out what’s real and what’s not is to just pretend some {i}god{/i} sees it instead and already knows the answer.
lines.zh: : 哦，好。所以判断真假的大课就是：假装某个{i}神{/i}替你看见、并且已经知道答案。

lines.en: : That way, I can just decide what exists on my own and rationalize it as divine truth when, in all actuality, it’s just a big game of pretend and imagining something is real when it’s not.
lines.zh: : 这样我就可以自己决定什么存在，还把它合理化成神圣真理——而实际上，那只是一场大型的假装游戏，是把不存在的东西想象成真的。

lines.en: scene yasudormevent12
: That is where you’re mistaken.
lines.zh: : 你错就错在这儿。

lines.en: : Everything you can imagine is real.
lines.zh: : 你能想象的一切都是真的。

lines.en: : If you think there aren’t enough stars in the sky, make more.
lines.zh: : 如果你觉得天上的星星不够多，就多造一些。

lines.en: : If you think the moon is too small or the sun is too large, change their shapes or sizes.
lines.zh: : 如果你觉得月亮太小、太阳太大，就改它们的形状和大小。

lines.en: : Learning to sever the invisible cord tying your imagination to the realm you reside in is the key to making everything you want reality.
lines.zh: : 学会斩断那根把你的想象力拴在你所居位面上的隐形绳索，是让你想要的一切成真的关键。

lines.en: : It could even help you see someone you’ve {i}longed{/i} to see for many years.
lines.zh: : 它甚至能帮你看���那个你多年{i}渴望{/i}见到的人。

lines.en: scene wearethechildren13
scene yasudormevent12
: It could help you {i}touch{/i} them.
lines.zh: : 它能帮你{i}触碰{/i}他们。

lines.en: scene wearethechildren13
scene yasudormevent12
: {i}Inseminate{/i} them.
lines.zh: : {i}让他们受孕{/i}。

lines.en: scene wearethechildren13
scene yasudormevent12
: Why, you could do anything you want.
lines.zh: : 为什么，你什么都能做。

lines.en: : That is the type of world we live in. {i}That{/i} is the type of place He has created.
lines.zh: : 这就是我们活在其中的那类世界。{i}这{/i}就是祂创造的那类地方。

lines.en: : But only those willing to unchain their minds will be able to make the most of this.
lines.zh: : 但只有那些愿意解开自己心智锁链的人，才能从中得到最多。

lines.en: scene yasudormevent13
: Others will call you crazy...because they don’t understand. But how could they?
lines.zh: : 别人会叫你疯子……因为他们不懂。可他们怎么懂得了？

lines.en: : They haven’t felt the warmth emanating off the hand of God — or filled their palms with sakura petals just to toss them in the air and let them rain down in a flurry of color.
lines.zh: : 他们没感受过神的手散发的温暖——也没捧满一手樱花花瓣、只为抛向空中，让它们在一阵色彩中如雨落下。

lines.en: : They haven’t felt anything at all, because they’ve already determined what they can and can not see.
lines.zh: : 他们什么都没感受过，因为他们早就断定自己能看见什么、不能看见什么。

lines.en: : They’ve made the mistake of defining their realities before learning their place in the world...while people like {i}you{/i} were never able to do that.
lines.zh: : 他们犯的错是：在弄清自己在世界上的位置之前，就先定义了自己的现实……而像{i}你{/i}这样的人，从来没能做到那一点。

lines.en: : What...do you mean?
lines.zh: : 你……什么意思？

lines.en: scene yasudormevent14
: {b}I MEAN YOU’RE FULL OF WORMS! PLACED THERE BY SOMEONE YOU THOUGHT YOU COULD TRUST!{/b}
lines.zh: : {b}我的意思是你满肚子都是虫子！是你以为可以信任的人放进去的！{/b}

lines.en: : {b}There was never a chance for you to define a reality because you were too busy trying to survive in the one that was left there for you!{/b}
lines.zh: : {b}你从来没有机会去定义一个现实，因为你忙着在别人丢给你的那个现实里活下去！{/b}

lines.en: : {b}In the shadow of those dying lights that danced across your wall as cars passed by, you prayed for something more! Did you not?!{/b}
lines.zh: : {b}在车子驶过、那些垂死的光在你墙上跳舞的影子里，你祈祷着更多东西！不是吗？！{/b}

lines.en: : {b}As you hid beneath the covers and wished the world would end, you prayed someone would take you away! DID YOU NOT?!{/b}
lines.zh: : {b}当你躲在被子里、盼着世界完蛋的时候，你祈祷有人来把你带走！不是吗？！{/b}

lines.en: : {b}Then, when someone finally {i}did,{/i} you prayed they’d send you back! You prayed you never learned to feel at all!!!{/b}
lines.zh: : {b}然后，终于有人那么{i}做了{/i}，你又祈祷他们把你送回去！你祈祷自己永远没学会感受！！！{/b}

lines.en: : {b}DID YOU NOT?!?!?!?!?{/b}
: {b}Your life has been nothing but praying! Praying and hurting and hurting and praying! And {i}now{/i} you laugh in the FACE OF GOD because he never answered you BACK THEN?! NOW?!{/b}
lines.zh: : {b}你这一辈子除了祈祷什么都不是！祈祷、受伤、受伤、祈祷！而{i}现在{/i}你当面嘲笑神，就因为祂那时候没回答你？！现在？！{/b}

lines.en: : {b}THE REASON YOU HURT AS MUCH AS YOU DO IS BECAUSE YOU THREW HIM AWAY!{/b}
lines.zh: : {b}你之所以痛得这么深，是因为你把祂扔掉了！{/b}

lines.en: scene yasudormevent15
: But He will take you back...
lines.zh: : 但祂会收你回去……

lines.en: : Because He is all-forgiving.
lines.zh: : 因为祂是完全宽恕的。

lines.en: : He is all-loving.
lines.zh: : 祂是完全慈爱的。

lines.en: : And you’re just a container for wiggling detritivores, relying on a {b}RETARDED VIRGIN CUNT{/b} to come and {i}save{/i} you instead of figuring out a proper coping mechanism. {b}GET REAL, FUCKER.{/b}
lines.zh: : 而你不过是一具装着蠕动腐食者的容器，指望着一个{b}弱智处女的屄{/b}来{i}救{/i}你，而不是去想出一个像样的应对机制。{b}现实点吧，傻逼{/b}。

lines.en: : Eat shit and die.
lines.zh: : 吃屎去死吧。

lines.en: : Who...
: Who...{i}are{/i} you?...
scene yasudormevent16
scene yasudormevent17
: What...
lines.zh: : 什么……

lines.en: : What’s?...
scene yasudormevent18
: Ahh...
: Yasu, are you...okay?
lines.zh: : Yasu，你……还好吗？

lines.en: scene yasudormevent19
: Don’t look at me...
lines.zh: : 别看我……

lines.en: : Yasu, I think something might be-
lines.zh: : Yasu，我觉得有什么——

lines.en: scene yasudormevent20
: I SAID DON’T LOOK AT ME!!!
lines.zh: : 我说了别看我！！！

lines.en: scene black
I slowly back away and press myself up against the base of a well.
lines.zh: 我慢慢后退，把背贴在一口井的井基上。

lines.en: And it isn’t until I hear her wring her dress out in the water that I understand what must have happened.
lines.zh: 直到听见她在水里拧自己裙子的声音，我才明白刚才一定发生了什么。

lines.en: scene clearnightsky
Something’s wrong with Yasu.
lines.zh: Yasu 身上有东西不对劲。

lines.en: It’s not just religious fanaticism.
lines.zh: 不只是宗教狂热。

lines.en: There’s something inside her.
lines.zh: 她体内有某个东西。

lines.en: And I don’t know how to get it out.
lines.zh: 而我不知道怎么把它弄出来。

lines.en: scene black
scene yasudormevent21
: Please...don’t tell anyone...what happened...
lines.zh: : 求你……别告诉任何人……发生了什么……

lines.en: : I won’t...
lines.zh: : 我不会……

lines.en: : If anything, this is the most human I’ve seen you all night.
lines.zh: : 要说的话，这是我整晚见过你最像人的一刻。

lines.en: : I don’t...
lines.zh: : 我不……

lines.en: : I don’t remember where or...
lines.zh: : 我不记得在哪儿、或者……

lines.en: : Or why we were...
lines.zh: : 或者我们为什么在……

lines.en: : Just go to sleep, Yasu. You’ll be better in the morning.
lines.zh: : 去睡吧，Yasu。明天早上你会好一点的。

lines.en: : I have to...take a shower...
lines.zh: : 我得……去洗个澡……

lines.en: : Right. Yeah.
lines.zh: : 对。是的。

lines.en: : Well, uhh...
: I guess I’ll...see you later then?
lines.zh: : 我想我……那回头见了？

lines.en: scene yasudormevent22
Yasu heads back into her room without saying goodnight.
lines.zh: Yasu 没说道晚安就回了房间。

lines.en: And I’m kind of glad she does...
lines.zh: 而我有点高兴她这么做……

lines.en: Because it spares me the possibility of making her even more confused.
lines.zh: 因为那让我免于把她弄得更糊涂。

lines.en: scene black
We had to take a taxi back from the beach.
lines.zh: 我们不得不打车从海滩回来。

lines.en: It put a hole in my wallet just as large as the one in my chest.
lines.zh: 那在我的钱包上开了个洞，跟我胸口那个一样大。

lines.en: Tonight, I awoke in a strange clearing with a girl from my class.
lines.zh: 今晚，我在一片陌生的空地上醒来，身边是班上的一个女孩。

lines.en: Or at least something using her body.
lines.zh: 或者至少是某个用着她身体的东西。

lines.en: I’m worried about her.
lines.zh: 我担心她。
